subject: Hotspot mitigation & temporary slot scheduling — ask for reservation + eviction policy tweak
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Hotspot mitigation & temporary slot scheduling — ask for reservation + eviction policy tweak

Team — quick context: Atlas ML is ramping a 6-week experiment that will spike requests to our Dedicated pool for the 80B family. They asked for a small reserved buffer (8 GPU slots) for weekdays 08:00–20:00 PT to avoid failed jobs during model warmup.

Why this matters: their telemetry shows a sharp tail of short-lived but high-concurrency jobs that overwhelm autoscale and cause cascaded evictions in the pilot pool. If we lose runs they’ve already indicated they’ll push back the pilot and escalate to procurement.

Ask: can we approve a temporary reservation for May 24 — Jun 30 (trial window) and waive the strict LRU eviction during the reserved window? Proposal is:
- 8-slot reservation pinned to pool-dedicated-us-west-2 (no more than 10% of that pilot pool)
- Autoscale remains active outside the reservation window; during reserved hours we enforce soft-eviction policy: prefer preemptible hosts, avoid KV-cache eviction unless >30min idle
- Ops to monitor and provide hourly rollback hook if interference observed

I've attached Atlas’s capacity estimates and a draft runbook.

Next steps I want: Aditya, ops feasibility and risk assessment. Dev, confirm whether runtime metrics (KV cache pressure, slot churn) can be surfaced to the Console dashboard in time. Lauren, any procurement implications for temporary carveout (billing, contract amendment)?

-Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 02:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Hotspot mitigation & temporary slot scheduling — ask for reservation + eviction policy tweak

Kim — thanks for the clear summary. Short answer: feasible with caveats.

Feasibility notes:
- We can carve an 8-slot reservation scoped to a tagged capacity pool and limit burst to that window. This is a low-risk config change (we've done similar for pilots), but it requires an infra change and a short maintenance window to apply the reservation rule (30–45m).
- The eviction tweak (prefer preemptible hosts, avoid KV eviction unless idle >30m) is implementable by adjusting the scheduler’s eviction scoring function for the reservation policy. That tweak is safe for a short trial but increases risk of hotspot propagation if the pool is heavily oversubscribed outside the reserved period.

Observability + rollback:
- Ops can add a temporary dashboard with KV cache pressure, slot churn, and per-tenant latency. We can also add an automated rollback runbook that will remove the reservation and re-enable standard eviction if tail latency > 2x baseline for 30 consecutive minutes.

Coordination needs:
- Need Ops time to implement the scheduler change and a small maintenance window (preferred weekend of May 22)
- Need legal/procurement sign-off for temporary billing adjustments (Lauren)
- Dev to confirm Console exposure for the three new metrics before May 24

I'll raise INF-2137 and assign to infra oncall for the implementation.

-Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Director, Serving Reliability
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 07:46:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Hotspot mitigation & temporary slot scheduling — ask for reservation + eviction policy tweak

Kim / Aditya — confirmed; Console can surface the following by May 23 if we prioritize:
- Per-tenant slot churn (1m rollup)
- KV cache hit ratio per tenant (5m rollup)
- Tail P95/P99 generation latency for the 80B family (1m rollup)

Work required: small API extension to tag reservation windows so telemetry returns scoped stats; estimate 1.5 engineer-days (I can carve out time if we treat this as high priority).

One implementation question: for the soft-eviction rule, do we want to escalate to full eviction if a tenant's memory pressure crosses 85% even during reserved hours? That would protect other tenants but could break Atlas runs. Suggest: keep the 85% threshold but increase the time-to-evict from 5m -> 20m during reservation window, with explicit Ops rollback on breach.

-Dev

--
Dev Patel
SRE, Serving Runtime
dev_patel@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Sara Holt <sara.holt@atlas-ml.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:34:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Hotspot mitigation & temporary slot scheduling — ask for reservation + eviction policy tweak

Thanks team — looping in Atlas procurement contact for transparency. Sara, we appreciate the detailed ask. A few procurement/contract notes before we greenlight: 

- Billing: we can do a temporary billed reservation (pass-through) for May 24 — Jun 30. We'll issue a one-line amendment to the pilot MSA (no material T&Cs changed) that documents the reservation size and billing rate.
- Credits: As a gesture, Sales requested a 15% credit on usage over the trial window if Atlas completes the full pilot (I’ll coordinate offline with Kimberly).
- Legal: We do not need a formal SLA change for a short trial; Ops removal/rollback clauses will be documented.

Action items assigned:
- Kimberly: coordinate the amendment signature with Atlas (Procure).
- Aditya: schedule the maintenance window and create INF-2137 with implementation tasks and rollback triggers.
- Dev: push the Console metrics by May 23; confirm the 20m TTE for eviction during reservation.

If everyone is aligned I’ll route the one-line amendment to Sara and Procure and give the go-ahead for the weekend change window.

-Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Contracts & Revenue Operations
l.bishop@redwood.ai
